# `StarLost`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

The guider dropped a frame because the guide star was lost, with frame diagnostics.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, socket_json_guider_server_event::NotifyStarLost @0x6ecd0 (64-bit guider build); 32-bit counterpart present |

Sent from the guider's dropped-frame information when the star is lost; one per affected frame, callback-driven, no helper throttle. Repeated losses can lead to GuideStarLostTooMuch. Sent by the guider process (zwoair_guider) on its TCP 4400 event server to every retained connection (G/all). The main imager process, which is a client of 4400, recognises event lines and forwards them unchanged onto TCP 4700 (I/all), so 4700 clients also receive it; the auxiliary imager process deliberately does not forward 4400 events. The imager's forwarding test is lexical (the exact text "Event":" in the line). Custom guider producer: no lowercase state, code or error; Status and ErrorCode are its own members. No Android app consumer is established. Ordering against RPC replies and other guider events is not guaranteed; no sequence number, replay or fixed cadence exists. Runtime reachability of the retained guiding functionality on every model is unresolved.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"StarLost"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string <seconds>.<nine digits> from clock id 1 (monotonic, INFERRED); not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `Frame` | integer | yes | - | Frame index. [READ] |
| `Time` | number | yes | - | Frame time; whether a timestamp or a duration, and its unit, are unresolved. Not the Timestamp. [READ (type); meaning and unit unresolved] |
| `StarMass` | number | yes | - | Star signal mass; scale unresolved. [READ (type); scale unresolved] |
| `SNR` | number | yes | - | Signal-to-noise ratio. [READ] |
| `AvgDist` | number | yes | - | Average distance; pixels INFERRED. [READ (type); unit INFERRED] |
| `Status` | string | yes | - | Reason/status text. [READ] |
| `ErrorCode` | integer | yes | - | Dropped-frame error enum value; the enum is not established. [READ (type); values unresolved] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.
